```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(REDCapR)
library(tidyverse)
library(eeptools)

setwd(dirname(getwd()))
source("00-paths.R")
```

using API token to get data from redcap
```{r}
df <- redcap_read_oneshot(redcap_uri = "https://redcap.osumc.edu/redcap/api/",
                                token = "1CAFA9314A9CE50CD402961B065DC9FA")$data
```

load data from T-drive
```{r}
df <- read.csv(file.path(paths$data, "P426HONC60BeWell_DATA_2021-08-18_0957.csv")) %>%
  na_if("")
```

cleaning
```{r}
demogs <- df %>%
  drop_na(race) %>%
  select(subject_number, dob, race, gender, antibiotics, current_smoke, past_smoker)
```

convert DOB to age in years
```{r}
demogs$dob <- as.Date(demogs$dob)
demogs$age <- floor(age_calc(demogs$dob, units = "years"))
demogs <- demogs %>% select(-dob)
```

create smoking status variable
```{r}
# 0 = never smoked, 1 = past smoker, 2 = current smoker 
demogs <- demogs %>%
  mutate(
    smoking_status = ifelse(demogs$current_smoke == 1, 2, ifelse(demogs$past_smoker == 1, 1, 0))
  ) %>%
  select(-past_smoker, -current_smoke)
```

change variable types to strings
```{r}
demogs2 <- demogs %>% 
  mutate(
    gender = ifelse(demogs$gender == 1, "male", "female"),
    race = ifelse(demogs$race == 2, "Asian", ifelse(demogs$race == 4, "Black or African American", "White")),
    smoking_status = ifelse(demogs$smoking_status == 1, "past smoker", ifelse(demogs$smoking_status == 2, "current smoker", "never smoked")),
    antibiotics = 
  )
```
